snapshot.title: Add accessible exit / HUD toggle for PWA mobile
snapshot.description: The PWA header (Exit button) is currently hidden on mobile. Users need a way to exit the PWA or access navigation without it cluttering the game screen. Implement a tap-to-show HUD pattern (e.g. tap top edge reveals header briefly, then auto-hides).
